_note: PF-18a part 2 (AG-16-10, AG-16-11): the eight notification groups of My account → Notifications, as data: each group's words, who sees it and its In-app and Email defaults. Taken from AG-16 v1.24 (25 Oct 2026) §3.3 'Staff notifications' (the table and the 'Defaults' line), requirement snapshot requirements-2026-11-02, read 19 Nov 2026; every value below quotes that text, nothing is invented. The group codes are PF-18np's NotificationGroup enum (ports/notifications.ts): the app refuses this file unless it names exactly those eight, once each. The labels are the one place the screen's English words live (AG-16-11: English only in Release 1, translation-ready). The switches are per group (AG-16-10); in group 7 the items §3.3 marks 'in-app only, email off' never send an email whatever the switch: that is the sender's rule (PF-18n), listed here as emailNeverItems.

securityEmails.label: Security emails (new sign-in, password change)
securityEmails.quote: Security emails (new sign-in, password change) are always on, with no switch.

groups.label: Work handed to me
groups.whatIsInIt: A case, task or lead assigned to me (including a new lead and a handover); a review requested from me; my review sent back; a client booked a consultation with me.

groups.label: Needs you
groups.whatIsInIt: An item waiting for me in Needs you.

groups.label: My deadlines and reminders
groups.whatIsInIt: Government deadlines on my cases; the target filing date; the expiry watch; my overdue tasks; reminders I set for myself.

groups.label: A client or lead messaged me
groups.whatIsInIt: A client or lead messaged me, including one alert when a WhatsApp chat starts.

groups.label: Team watch
groups.whatIsInIt: A deadline nobody is watching; escalation alerts; work left unassigned after someone left; how new leads are shared went back to Anyone takes it.

groups.label: Payments
groups.whatIsInIt: Payment failed; invoice overdue (email on). Payment received; invoice sent; refund; dunning escalation (in-app only).
groups.emailQuote: On for payment failed and invoice overdue; off for the rest

groups.label: Firm and connections
groups.whatIsInIt: Connection problem; token expiring; payment account paused.
